brief:
The head of Israel's Mossad intelligence agency, Roman Gofman, advocated for coordinated US-Israeli military strikes against Iran during meetings with American officials last week, according to two people briefed on the visit. The lobbying effort occurred as tensions between Israel and Iran remained elevated following recent exchanges of fire.

Gofman's discussions with US counterparts focused on Israel's concerns regarding Iran's nuclear and military capabilities. The visit took place amid differing assessments between Washington and Jerusalem over the scope and timing of potential military action.
dek: By Alexander Cornwell JERUSALEM, Nov 18 (Reuters) - The head of Israel's Mossad spy agency, Roman Gofman, advocated for joint US-Israeli strikes on Iran during meetings with US officials last week, according to two people briefed on the visit.
title: Israel's spy chief urged joint US strikes on Iran
